name: VOID STRIKE
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One STARFARERS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

name: Opponent’s turn
legend:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One STARFARERS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

name: REDEPLOY
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One STARFARERS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

name: LOST SIGNAL
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One STARFARERS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [PRECISION].

name: COMBINED ARMS
type: Allied Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
description:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One unit from your army.

EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE] and +1 AP.

name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll.

TARGET: That unit or model from your army.

EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

name: SMOKESCREEN
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SMOKE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.
  • Smoke rises.

name: NORMAL MOVE
description: Move each model up to its Move characteristic.

name: GO TO GROUND
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit has 6+ InSv.

name: ALL IN
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Your army.

EFFECT: Gain 1CP.
